hooks.logic:
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  If ability is the id of the move labelled "insult" on the enemy, then run helper on "insult".
  Otherwise, if ability is the id of the move labelled "mimic_daravon" on the enemy, then run helper on "mimic_daravon".
  Otherwise, call game:ai.AiUtil.registerAbilityWithIntroMessageByConfs with (the enemy, list, {abilityId: ability}).

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
ability is the id of the move labelled "insult" on the enemy

no.text: ability is the id of the move labelled "mimic_daravon" on the enemy

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled arg on the enemy.
The enemy uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityTag: arg}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: data at arg}]]}, conditions: {anyCanHit: true}}].

flow.text: Let ability be the id of the move labelled arg on the enemy.

The enemy uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityTag: arg}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: data at arg}]]}, conditions: {anyCanHit: true}}].
